quote: A vehicle shall not be turned so as to proceed in the opposite direction upon any curve, or upon the approach to or near the crest of a grade, where such vehicle cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

activation.condition: Vehicle is turned to proceed in the opposite direction upon a curve or upon approach to or near a grade crest, with the statutory visibility circumstance.

obligation.description: A vehicle must not be turned to proceed in the opposite direction where it cannot be seen by a driver of another vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet.

timing.description: Original reversal and approach-direction sight evidence must be joined at the actual turn interval.

judgment_calls_needed.phrase: cannot be seen by the driver of any other vehicle approaching from either direction within 500 feet
judgment_calls_needed.note: Source-bound geometric rays do not establish what a real other driver could see; retain the legal judgment unresolved.

parameter_refs.name: turn_location_class
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: curve, approach to crest, or near crest on the original road

parameter_refs.name: approach_direction
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: either direction of original approaching traffic

parameter_refs.name: road_sight_geometry
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: original geometry and terrain occluders, source measured at stations through 500 feet

parameter_refs.name: reversal_controller
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: actual original-heading reversal on the fixed road

parameter_refs.name: approaching_vehicle_distance
parameter_refs.range_or_domain: planned below, at and above 500 feet from the turning vehicle at the original turn interval
